data.text: I’m with Kate: I’ll choose 10 tons this month. My family taught me to leave enough fish for the next trip, and a shared 50-ton limit lets all five of us earn steadily without shrinking the lake. Luke, you’re welcome to an equal share—you don’t need to sit out. Let’s check the revealed catches together each month and adjust our limits if the stock falls below 100. John, can you commit to 10 as well?
